  • Class Summary 
    Class Description
    CachedCalculation<T,​EXCEPTION extends Throwable>
    Wrapper for an often needed expensive calculation that caches the result for a while and only repeats the calculation on when the value is requested and the cache timed out, and performs the neccesary locking to exclude parallel executions.
    ExceptionUtil
    Utilities related to exceptions.
    FileRequestLog
    The FileRequestLog class extracted from the default Sling FileRequestLog
    FileResourceDataSource
    Presents a FileHandle as a javax.activation.DataSource, primarily for reading it.
    JcrIteratorUtil
    Stuff related to foreach loops - turing ancient pre java-5 iterators into proper iterables.
    LazyInputStream
    An InputStream that wraps around another input stream, actually creating it only once it's actually used.
    LockAsAutoCloseable
    Allows using a Lock with a try with resources, e.g.: try (LockAsAutoCloseable locked = LockAsAutoCloseable.lock(lock)) { ...
    OutputStreamInputStreamAdapter
    Creates an InputStream from a callable that can write data to an OutputStream only.
    ScheduledExecutorServiceFromExecutorService
    Adapter that turns an ExecutorService (such as SlingThreadPoolExecutorService) into an ScheduledExecutorService.
    ScheduledExecutorServiceFromExecutorService.AbstractDelegatedScheduledFuture<V>
    Presents a Future as a ScheduledFuture: all calls are forwarded to future, except Delayed.getDelay(TimeUnit) which needs to be implemented in derived classes.
    ScheduledExecutorServiceFromExecutorService.DelayedTask<V>
    Stores the necessary data for one (scheduled) task to be executed.
    SlingThreadPoolExecutorService
    Adapter for a Sling ThreadPool which presents it as an ExecutorService, since that is required for many uses of thread pools.
    TokenUtil
    Some support utilities to create a token containing several pieces of information such that these can be put together and later extracted safely again.
